classification_definitions.integration: Core observable assertion materially crosses real production filesystem/network/service/store/process boundary. Synthetic clients or incidental filesystem setup do not count.

classification_definitions.mixed: Separate independent integration and local-only assertion blocks.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Core assertion not established from connected canonical source, including explicit setup blockers.

floor_artifact.text:
func (checker *FounderPeerContinuation) checkBindings(marker AcceptedInstall, state bootstrap.SlotState,
	selected currentFounderPeerSelection, now time.Time,
) error {
	if marker.validate() != nil || marker.Slot == marker.SeedSlot ||
		checker.reader.accepted.Slot != marker.Slot ||
		checker.reader.accepted.SeedSlot != marker.SeedSlot ||
		checker.reader.accepted.AnchorSHA256 != marker.AnchorSHA256 ||
		checker.reader.accepted.ManifestSHA256 != marker.ManifestSHA256 ||
		!selected.Anchor.IsVerified() || selected.Plan == nil || !selected.Plan.IsVerified() ||
		selected.Anchor.Digest() != marker.AnchorSHA256 ||
		selected.Plan.Digest() != state.Intent.FounderPlanSHA256 ||
		state.Intent.SchemaVersion != 1 || state.Intent.Mode != bootstrap.IntentModeManaged ||
		state.Head.SchemaVersion != 1 || state.Head.ResultDigest != marker.ResultSHA256 ||
		state.Result == nil || state.ResultRecord == nil || state.Candidate == nil || state.CandidateRecord == nil ||
		state.ManifestRecord == nil || state.PeerReceiptRecord == nil ||
		state.ResultRecord.SHA256 != marker.ResultSHA256 ||
		state.PeerReceiptRecord.SHA256 != marker.ReceiptSHA256 ||
		state.ManifestRecord.SHA256 != marker.ManifestSHA256 ||
		state.Head.CandidateDigest != state.CandidateRecord.SHA256 ||
		state.Head.ResultDigest != state.ResultRecord.SHA256 ||
		state.Candidate.InstanceOCID != marker.InstanceOCID || state.Result.InstanceOCID != marker.InstanceOCID ||
		state.Result.Mode != bootstrap.IntentModeManaged ||
		state.Intent.DeploymentID != marker.DeploymentID || state.Intent.Cell != marker.Cell ||
		state.Intent.Slot != marker.Slot || state.Intent.ManifestDigest != marker.ManifestSHA256 ||
		state.Result.DeploymentID != marker.DeploymentID || state.Result.Cell != marker.Cell ||
		state.Result.Slot != marker.Slot || state.Candidate.DeploymentID != marker.DeploymentID ||
		state.Candidate.Cell != marker.Cell || state.Candidate.Slot != marker.Slot ||
		state.Intent.ImageOCID != marker.ImageOCID ||
		state.Head.Attempt != marker.HeadAttempt || state.Head.Generation != marker.HeadGeneration ||
		state.Candidate.IntentDigest != state.IntentRecord.SHA256 ||
		state.Result.IntentDigest != state.IntentRecord.SHA256 ||
		state.Candidate.FounderPlanSHA256 != state.Intent.FounderPlanSHA256 ||
		state.Candidate.PeerRowDigest != state.Intent.PeerRowDigest ||
		state.Candidate.ManifestDigest != state.Intent.ManifestDigest {
		return ErrFounderPeerContinuation
	}
	if selected.Plan.SeedSlot() != marker.SeedSlot ||
		selected.SelectionGeneration == 0 || !now.Before(selected.SelectionExpiresAt) ||
		!selected.Plan.StoredCompletionBeforeLaunchDeadline(state.ResultRecord.LastModified,
			state.HeadRecord.LastModified) ||
		digestWire(selected.ManifestWires[marker.Slot]) != marker.ManifestSHA256 {
		return ErrFounderPeerContinuation
	}
	row, ok := selected.Plan.PeerRow(marker.Slot)
	if ok {
		rowDigest, err := bootstrap.FounderPeerRowDigest(row)
		if err == nil && rowDigest == state.Intent.PeerRowDigest &&
			row.ManifestSHA256 == marker.ManifestSHA256 && row.ImageOCID == marker.ImageOCID &&
			row.CompartmentOCID == state.Intent.CompartmentOCID {
			return nil
		}
	}
	return ErrFounderPeerContinuation
}

external_seed.text:
func VerifyExternalSeedObservation(anchor bootstrap.VerifiedBootstrapAnchor,
	manifest bootstrap.StartupAuthority, state bootstrap.SlotState,
	observed InstanceObservation, expectedPrivateIP string,
) (bootstrap.InstanceFacts, error) {
	if manifest == nil || !anchor.IsVerified() || manifest.Digest() == "" || state.IntentRecord.SHA256 == "" ||
		state.Intent.Mode != bootstrap.IntentModeExternalSeed || state.Intent.SchemaVersion != 1 ||
		state.Intent.Attempt != 1 || state.Intent.Generation != 1 ||
		state.Head.Attempt != 1 || state.Head.Generation != 1 ||
		state.Head.IntentDigest != state.IntentRecord.SHA256 ||
		state.Intent.ManifestDigest != manifest.Digest() ||
		state.Intent.Slot != manifest.Manifest().SeedSlot ||
		state.Intent.DeploymentID != anchor.Anchor().DeploymentID ||
		state.Intent.Cell != string(anchor.Anchor().Cell) ||
		state.Intent.Environment != anchor.Anchor().Environment {
		return bootstrap.InstanceFacts{}, ErrExternalSeedObservation
	}
	intent := state.Intent
	profile, ok := manifest.Profile(intent.Slot)
	if !ok || profile.CompartmentOCID != intent.CompartmentOCID ||
		profile.AvailabilityDomain != intent.AvailabilityDomain ||
		profile.FaultDomain != intent.FaultDomain || profile.SubnetOCID != intent.SubnetOCID ||
		profile.Shape != intent.Shape || !sameOCIDSet(profile.NetworkSecurityGroupOCIDs, intent.NetworkSecurityGroupIDs) ||
		observed.InstanceOCID == "" || observed.BootstrapCreateKey != intent.CreateKey ||
		observed.CompartmentOCID != intent.CompartmentOCID || observed.ImageOCID != intent.ImageOCID ||
		observed.AvailabilityDomain != intent.AvailabilityDomain || observed.FaultDomain != intent.FaultDomain ||
		observed.Shape != intent.Shape || observed.SubnetOCID != intent.SubnetOCID ||
		!sameOCIDSet(observed.NSGOCIDs, intent.NetworkSecurityGroupIDs) ||
		!observed.PrimaryVNIC || observed.PrimaryVNICOCID == "" ||
		observed.PrimaryPrivateIP != expectedPrivateIP || observed.ETag == "" ||
		observed.LifecycleState != "RUNNING" {
		return bootstrap.InstanceFacts{}, ErrExternalSeedObservation
	}
	profile.NetworkSecurityGroupOCIDs = slices.Clone(profile.NetworkSecurityGroupOCIDs)
	return bootstrap.InstanceFacts{
		DeploymentID: intent.DeploymentID, Environment: intent.Environment,
		ClusterID: anchor.Anchor().ClusterID, Cell: anchor.Anchor().Cell,
		OCIRegion: intent.OCIRegion, Role: intent.Role, Slot: intent.Slot,
		InstanceOCID: observed.InstanceOCID, CompartmentOCID: observed.CompartmentOCID,
		ImageOCID: observed.ImageOCID, CreateKey: intent.CreateKey,
		IntentSHA256: state.IntentRecord.SHA256, Profile: profile,
	}, nil
}

Fixture storage maps and fake OCI are synthetic; no cloud/Object Storage/NATS boundary is inferred. Real SDK HTTP setup is not credited when the root cannot reach its assertions.
Filesystem reads/writes qualify only the explicit inventory/floor/marker/fact effects; no power-loss, production deployment, live secret delivery or crash durability is established.
No source/repository/ledger/runtime mutation, retirement, deletion, global count promotion or completion credit.
